row.team_price_text: Starter: priced from $30/mo + 2.5% of partner-driven transactions
row.evidence: impact.com's pricing page lists SAML from the Pro edition (priced from $2,500/mo); its help centre documents SAML SSO with AD FS, Okta, OneLogin and Entra ID, enabled per invited user, and has no SCIM or automated provisioning article.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. Scored as the impact.com brand (advertiser) account; vendor name is impact.com (Partnership Cloud). No SCIM documented in the help centre or the Integrations Hub (llms.txt indexes of both searched). Users are invited by email, then switched to SAML one by one; the IdP email must match an existing user, so there is no documented JIT. Plans are flat monthly 'priced from' fees (annual payment possible) plus a 2.5% transaction fee, so per-user fields are null. The Brand API has no user endpoints; the Partner API only lists/gets partner-account users (read-only). Okta's OIN 'Impact Radius' app is SWA only (last updated Feb. 18 2015; checked items read from page markup).

scim.notes: No SCIM page in help.impact.com/llms.txt or integrations.impact.com/llms.txt (0 hits for 'scim'). false is by absence (rule 5).

user_api.notes: Brand API reference sections (accounts, actions, partners, contracts, etc.) contain no account-user endpoints; brand accounts are created or closed via the CSM. The Partner API (for publisher accounts) has read-only GET /Mediapartners/{AccountSID}/Users and /Users/{Id} with HTTP Basic (AccountSID:AuthToken); no create, update or remove. Not counted as a user-management API for the brand product.

okta.notes: OIN 'Impact Radius' app is SWA only (checked items read from page markup). impact.com's own guide uses a custom SAML connection in Okta, so SAML SSO works with Okta but not via the catalogue app.

entra.notes: impact.com's guide creates a custom connection in Entra ID.

onelogin.notes: OneLogin is a supported SAML provider per impact.com's guide; OneLogin catalogue not checked.

fallbacks.notes: Users are invited by email and given predefined or custom roles via User Access Groups; SAML is switched on per existing user. JIT is not documented.
